limitations: Exactly two finite-dimensional symmetric negative-semidefinite factors, exact first phi function and tensor product. No extension claimed to nonnormal factors, more directions, other phi functions, nonlinear time stepping, or floating-point error.
scientific_integrity: Analytical all-dimension proof; computational checks are supplementary; no claim of independent certification, implementation validation or priority beyond literature examined.
title: A sharp universal error bound for two-direction splitting of the first matrix exponential integral
